/usr/bin/bash -lc "jq '
  . as "'$plan |
  {
    selected_rules: [$plan.rules[].rule],
    entity_repairs: [
      ($plan.rules[] | . as $rule | .files[] | {
        rule: $rule.rule,
        relative_path: .relative_path,
        locations: .locations,
        entities: (
          if $rule.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var" then ["Index.message"]
          elif $rule.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-use-id-in-get-resource-sync-api" then ["Index.message resource lookup"]
          else ["Index.result accumulation in read and write test routines"] end
        ),
        evidence: (
          if $rule.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var" then ["Index.ets declares message with a fixed resource-derived string and never assigns it after initialization.", "Button reads message only for its label."]
          elif $rule.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-use-id-in-get-resource-sync-api" then ["Index.ets calls ResourceManager.getStringSync for app.string.run.", "The mounted OpenHarmony ResourceManager declaration accepts a numeric resource ID for getStringSync."]
          else ["Index.ets renders result from Text and appends output from the click handler.", "The reported routines now build output in local result variables and return it; the click handler performs the single UI state update after preserving the original call order."] end
        ),
        transformation: (
          if $rule.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-remove-unchanged-state-var" then "Removed the @State decorator from message while retaining its private declaration and initialization."
          elif $rule.rule == "@performance/hp-arkui-use-id-in-get-resource-sync-api" then "Passed $r('"\\\"app.string.run\\\").id to getStringSync so the resource lookup uses the numeric ID API.\"
          else \"Changed each affected read/write test routine to accumulate text in a local result variable and return it; the click handler concatenates those returns in the existing order and updates the rendered @State result once.\" end
        ),
        status: \"repaired\"
      })
    ],
    blocked: [],
    unresolved_external: []
  }
' .exp_agent/round_01/plan.json > .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json
jq '{selected_rules, entity_repairs: [.entity_repairs[] | {rule, relative_path, location_count: (.locations|length), entities, evidence_count: (.evidence|length), status}], blocked, unresolved_external}' .exp_agent/round_01/completion.json"
